topics.topic: Whether later backups include or always remove agent-session records
questions: Does the later backup contain agent-session records present at its snapshot, or are those records always removed?

quotes: A backup holds every record but the agent sessions (M06), which are removed from the copy before it is encrypted, so the copy is a store of its own that passes the same checks; Registry's other invariants are not checked again in it, its transactions having kept them: a store restored from it has no session, Kernel registers its sessions again and the owner grants them again, so a restore never brings back a grant revoked after the backup.
judgement.why: The explicit agent-session exception answers that every backup removes agent sessions, while “whatever the store holds” describes which committed store state the later snapshot observes before that removal.
